## Install

**macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)** — download the `.dmg`, open it, and drag keepsake360 into Applications. This build is not notarized yet, so the first launch shows "Apple could not verify…": open System Settings → Privacy & Security, then choose Open Anyway.

**Windows** — download the `Setup.exe` and run it. If SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher, choose More info → Run anyway.

The macOS `.zip` is the same app, kept so auto-updates can use it later; you don't need it to install. Linux packages aren't part of this release.

The "Source code (zip)" and "Source code (tar.gz)" files in the asset list are generated by GitHub from the tag — they are not installers.
